deadline.value: Fall entry only. Apply by March 1 as an international applicant (July 1 for domestic). February 15 is the priority date for a teaching assistantship.
deadline.quote: Submission deadline is July 1 for domestic applicants and March 1 for international applicants.

also.quote: Applications must be submitted by the priority deadline of February 15 to be considered for a graduate assistantship.

gre_general.value: The statistics PhD does not require the General GRE.
gre_general.quote: This program does not require the General GRE.

gre_subject.value: The department says neither the General GRE nor any GRE Subject Test is required for doctoral admission.
gre_subject.quote: Neither the GRE General Test nor any GRE Subject Tests are required for admission to the Master’s or doctoral programs.

supervisor.value: The statistics pages checked do not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The department usually has five to seven teaching assistantships a year and offers no non-teaching financial aid, so funding is limited.
funding.quote: The department does not offer non-teaching financial aid.

also.quote: we usually have five to seven positions available.
